title: Best Bicycle Kicks Of All Time
method: Overview plus continuous video frames; detailed movement sampled from the three replay sequences.
observations: Arms swing for takeoff and spread as counterbalance.
Non-striking leg rises first and exchanges with the extended striking leg in a scissor.
Torso opens close to horizontal at impact; head follows torso with a small chin tuck.
Legs continue through the strike and arms open to cushion back/shoulder landing.
